title: 第25章 白宫会所，牲口啊
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“西海！”

    李西雄哥俩一起出去，坐的是李西朋的车。

    要是开李西雄或者李西英的车，去市里的话，在白宫会所被人遇到，不好说的。

    虽说这概率很低。

    但保密工作小心没大错的。

    李西海上车后，就直接往市里开去。

    路况好的话，四十多分钟就到了，路况一般，就要一个小时。

    偏偏今天是周五。

    江云去市里的车不少，路况有点差，开了一个多小时才到的市里。

    其实江云不是没娱乐场所的，但这次李西雄是铁了心，要再去白宫会所浪一圈，狠狠消费一波，装装大爷，体验有钱人的快感。

    江云可给不了，也容易遇到熟人。

    晚上九点过。

    汽车缓缓在会所小弟的指引下，停在白宫会所的停车场。

    白宫会所是金碧辉煌，李西海与李西朋还是第一次来这里。

    看到这外边就跟白宫差不多，就有点惊叹。

    见识少了啊。

    空气中都弥漫着一股堕落与金钱的味道。

    “哥，有预约吗？”

    小弟恭谨带笑的问道。

    “有。”

    李西雄爆出电话，姓氏。

    小弟里面就通过耳机，告知前台。

    他们刚进门领队就在门口迎接。

    “李哥，欢迎来到白宫会所。”

    领队微笑着说道：“包间已经给你安排好了。”

    “这边请。”

    李西海一边走，一边打量着白宫会所的装饰，确实高端大气上档次。

    就连前台小妹，颜值身段也不低。

    经过的服务员见到他们一行人，都主动停下，站到过道边，微笑招呼。

    “哥，不愧是林江最奢华最顶尖的会所。”

    “服务员的质量都这么高。”

    李西朋低声说道。

    李西海点了点头，保持淡然。

    很快，来到包房，一个很大的房间。

    宽敞，明亮，布置得当，在大屏幕下还有个小型舞台。

    “怎么样，不是江云能比的吧？”

    李西英笑着说道。

    李西朋大大咧咧的坐着，道：“哥，地方是不错，但江云这种包间还是有拿得出手的。”

    “就是不知道质量怎么样。”

    他又不是没在娱乐场所玩过，年轻单身想怎么玩就怎么玩。

    只是没到这里来消费过。
content_en:
"Western Sea!"

    The two brothers Li Xixiong went out together and took Li Xipeng's car.

    If you drive Li Xixiong or Li Xiying's car and go to the city, you will be met at the White House Club. It's hard to say.

    Although the probability is very low.

    But there is nothing wrong with being careful about confidentiality.

    After Li Xihai got in the car, he drove directly to the city.

    If the road conditions are good, it will take more than forty minutes. If the road conditions are average, it will take an hour.

    It just so happens that today is Friday.

    Jiang Yun had a lot of cars going to the city, and the road conditions were a bit bad. It took him more than an hour to get to the city.

    In fact, Jiang Yun is not without entertainment venues, but this time Li Xixiong is determined to go to the White House Club again, spend a lot of money, pretend to be a gentleman, and experience the pleasure of being rich.

    Jiang Yun couldn't give it, and it was easy to meet acquaintances.

    It's after nine o'clock in the evening.

    The car slowly parked in the parking lot of the White House Club under the guidance of the club boy.

    The White House Club is magnificent, and it is the first time for Li Xihai and Li Xipeng to come here.

    I was a little surprised when I saw that it looked like the White House outside.

    I don’t have enough knowledge.

    There is a smell of depravity and money in the air.

    "Brother, do you have an appointment?"

    The younger brother asked respectfully with a smile.

    "Yes."

    Li Xixiong revealed his phone number and surname.

    The boy inside informed the front desk through the earphone.

    The leader greeted them at the door as soon as they entered.

    "Brother Li, welcome to the White House Club."

    The team leader smiled and said: "The private room has been arranged for you."

    "This way please."

    As Li Xihai walked, he looked at the decoration of the White House Club. It was indeed high-end and classy.

    Even the girl at the front desk has good looks and good figure.

    When the waiters passing by saw their group, they stopped and stood by the aisle, smiling and saying hello.

    "Brother, this is indeed the most luxurious and top-notch club in Linjiang."

    “The quality of the waiters is so high.”

    Li Xipeng said in a low voice.

    Li Xihai nodded and remained calm.

    Soon, we came to the private room, a large room.

    It's spacious, bright and well-organized, with a small stage under the big screen.

    "How about it? Jiang Yun can't compare, right?"

    Li Xiying said with a smile.

    Li Xipeng sat down carelessly and said, "Brother, the place is good, but there are private rooms like Jiang Yun that can be used."

    “I just don’t know what the quality is like.”

    It's not like he has never played in entertainment venues before, and he can play as young and single as he wants.

    I just haven’t been here to spend money.
